title: Residual-aware mixture sampling for compact point supervision
question: Does allocating compact-trainer point attempts through a residual-aware mixture (uniform exploration, teacher-Gaussian proposal, residual-EMA proposal) reach matched held-out compact risk with fewer teacher queries, fewer attempted points, and less wall time than the current fixed pixel_gaussian mixture?
hypothesis: A 25/25/50 uniform/teacher-proposal/residual-EMA mixture with a probability floor and clipped mixture importance weights reaches the matched held-out compact risk target faster than the current default at 128 attempts, and holds that risk at 96 and 64 attempts where the default degrades; removing the uniform floor (hard-only control) collapses coverage and worst-view quality.
claim_boundary: Development evidence for point-sampling policy efficiency inside the RGB-free compact trainer on the two development-exposed stage frames. Wall-clock claims come only from paired measured repeats on the frozen host. Full-view RGB quality of saved models is measured exclusively by the separate cross-process offline image evaluator; no image enters this arm. It establishes no cross-scene generality, no production default change, and no claim about topology policies or Gaussian active-set masking (separately registered).

stages.label: Load compact fields
stages.purpose: Load integrity-checked 2D Gaussian bundles and calibrated cameras without any image-capable loader.

stages.label: Shared frozen initialization
stages.purpose: Construct one hash-verified 3D initialization used identically by every cell so only the sampling policy differs.

stages.label: Residual EMA tile cache
stages.purpose: Maintain one low-resolution per-view residual EMA (one value per 16x16 tile) updated only from tiles touched by ordinarily sampled points; no full-view render or scoring pass may be spent constructing the distribution.

stages.label: Compact optimization under the cell's mixture
stages.purpose: Run the RGB-free compact trainer with the frozen attempt budget and the cell's hierarchical sampling mixture q(v)q(t|v)q(x|t), reporting the clipped importance-weighted risk estimate and the unweighted selected-point loss separately.

stages.label: Held-out compact evaluation
stages.purpose: Evaluate every cell on identical held-out compact fields at the matched budgets and at the matched-risk stopping point.

comparators.label: Current default mixture, 128 attempts
comparators.purpose: The shipped pixel_gaussian proposal with uniform_fraction 0.25 at the default attempt budget; the status-quo anchor.

comparators.label: Residual mixture, 128 attempts
comparators.purpose: 25% uniform exploration, 25% teacher-Gaussian proposal, 50% residual-EMA proposal at the same attempt budget; the treatment at equal work.

comparators.label: Residual mixture, 96 attempts
comparators.purpose: Reduced attempt budget; tests whether adaptive allocation sustains matched risk with 25% fewer point queries.

comparators.label: Residual mixture, 64 attempts
comparators.purpose: Half attempt budget; bounds how much supervision the residual mixture can save before quality breaks.

comparators.label: Residual-only, no uniform floor
comparators.purpose: Negative control: residual proposal without uniform exploration; expected to collapse coverage and worst-view quality, proving the floor is load-bearing.

primary_metrics.label: Wall time to matched held-out compact risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over measured repeats, seeds, and scenes at the frozen risk target

primary_metrics.label: Teacher queries to matched risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Attempted points to matched risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact pixel risk at matched budget
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact area risk at matched budget
primary_metrics.aggregation: median per view, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Worst held-out view pixel risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: maximum over held-out views, then paired median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Unweighted selected-point loss
primary_metrics.aggregation: reported beside the importance-weighted estimate at frozen checkpoints; median over seeds and scenes

primary_metrics.label: Sampling mass per view and tile
primary_metrics.aggregation: per-view and per-tile mass histograms at frozen checkpoints; coverage floor violations counted

resource_protocol.scope: fresh reconstruction-only process from compact manifest open through final PLY save; the residual-cache bookkeeping is inside the measured boundary so adaptive selection pays for its own overhead
resource_protocol.aggregation: paired median on one idle named GPU; retain every raw repeat and report min/max

blockers: Implement the per-view residual EMA tile cache, the hierarchical mixture q(v)q(t|v)q(x|t) with a probability floor, and clipped mixture importance weighting behind an opt-in compact-trainer sampling config whose default preserves current behavior, with CPU-first tests for touched-tile-only cache updates, mixture normalization, floor enforcement, and importance-estimator unbiasedness on a tiny fixture.

Freeze the mixture weights (0.25/0.25/0.50), EMA decay beta, tile size, probability floor, importance-weight clip, matched held-out risk target, and stopping rule after a mechanism-only pilot, before setting status to ready.
Freeze the shared initialization artifact and its hash, the optimizer schedule, and the exact argv command before setting status to ready.
Freeze the CUDA host, GPU identity, and idle policy; wall-clock efficiency claims require the paired frozen-host protocol.
Record cross-process offline RGB evaluation of saved final models as a separate receipt outside this arm; no image-capable code may enter the reconstruction process.
Assign a frozen owner and obtain a distinct outcome-unseen prospective protocol review.
